quality_plan.mobile: Use GLB/glTF, 1K/2K textures, compressed audio, small chunk sizes, limited real-time lights, LODs.
quality_plan.desktop: Optional higher-resolution texture pack and additional environment props; keep assets separated by package.
quality_plan.offline: Download packages in explicit user-approved batches, verify sizes/hashes, then cache local files. Browser storage can be evicted.

automatic_download: A versão 0.4.5 testa a API, mostra erros e guarda modelos GLB/glTF e os recursos auxiliares do mesmo diretório. Requer HTTPS/localhost; abrir o HTML diretamente no iPad não permite Cache Storage persistente.
